summary: Operating a $2.7 billion rover on another planet means planning every move in advance across millions of miles of deep space. PERSEVERANCE: JEZERO MISSION CONTROL is an interactive engineering and mission-planning simulator built on real NASA Mars 2020 data. As a JPL Flight Director, you plot autonomous AutoNav waypoints across Jezero Crater and Neretva Vallis, balance battery reserves against wheel-slip hazards, run high-temperature $CO_2$ electrolysis on MOXIE, deploy the Ingenuity helicopter for aerial scouting, and drill biosignature rock cores like Cheyava Falls—all while pushing past Opportunity's historic driving record to reach 45.22 km.
details:
• What does it do or how does it work?
    • PERSEVERANCE: JEZERO MISSION CONTROL is a tactical engineering and mission-planning simulation game inspired by NASA's Mars 2020 Perseverance mission data.
    • It simulates the real-world 14-minute one-way light-time signal delay between Earth and Mars, requiring players (acting as JPL Flight Directors) to plan command sequences in advance.
    • Players plot up to 5 autonomous navigation waypoints across an interactive topographic map of Jezero Crater and Neretva Vallis, manage MMRTG battery reserves, control high-temperature ($800^\circ\text{C}$) $\text{CO}_2$ solid oxide electrolysis on MOXIE, deploy the Ingenuity helicopter for aerial scouting, and extract biosignature rock cores using SHERLOC/PIXL deep-UV Raman spectroscopy.
    • Translates complex planetary science data, autonomous robotics constraints, and real orbital mechanics into an engaging, interactive strategy experience.
    • Provides intuitive visual feedback on physical variables such as terrain resistance coefficients ($C_{\text{terrain}}$), velocity-squared power consumption models, and wheel-slip hazard probabilities.
    • To inspire students, space enthusiasts, and the public by demonstrating the rigorous engineering, decision-making, and scientific milestones behind real interplanetary rover missions.
    • To celebrate recent milestones of the Mars 2020 mission, such as surpassing the historic $45.22\text{ km}$ off-world driving record and validating potential biosignatures in the Cheyava Falls (Sapphire Canyon) sample.
    • Developed as a zero-dependency, single-file web application using HTML5 Canvas (for procedural map rendering, boulder generation, and real-time animation), Vanilla JavaScript (for core mission logic and telemetry math), and Tailwind CSS (for the aerospace dark-mode UI layout).
    • Built using principles of lightweight systems performance and extreme portability.
    • Combines rigorous NASA telemetry and mathematical physics formulas with an authentic Deep Space Network (DSN) and JPL Mission Control aesthetic.
    • Turns abstract mission constraints—like power budgeting and signal latency—into strategic gameplay elements where every watt and waypoint directly dictates mission survival and record-breaking progress.
    • Scientific Accuracy: Incorporating real parameters from NASA Mars 2020 data, including the exact driving milestone ($45.22\text{ km}$ record), MMRTG baseline recharge rates, MOXIE yield ratios, and specific geological zones of Jezero Crater.
    • User Experience & Performance: Ensuring instant, zero-setup browser accessibility and 60 FPS smooth rendering without requiring heavy external game engines or asset downloads.
